summary: Reusable `:server` file storage & image pipeline (§6.9): multipart upload validation by *magic bytes*, memory-safe image resize (≤2000 px) + 400 px thumbnail generation under `-Xmx256m`, `stored_files` metadata + disk cleanup, `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/{filename}` and `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/thumb/{filename}` with owner-based RGPD visibility, plus `PUT/DELETE /api/v1/me/avatar`. **Server only** (consumed by feature slices + Ktor Bearer download in web).
overview:
Cross-cutting server media slice required by Calendar (event image + gallery), Members (avatars), Inventory (item image), Groups/Achievements (logos/images), Figures (figure image), and Documents (protected 50 MB files).

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §6.9, §6.7 (`/me/avatar`), §8 (NFR-01 `-Xmx256m`) · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-server-infra` (`FILES_DIR`, `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, `DatabaseAccess`, `ErrorHandling`).
- `platform-schema-v02` (`stored_files` table and `*_file_id` columns).
- `platform-core-contract` (`FileRef` DTO).
- `platform-server-auth` (optional/required Bearer auth for conditional file download and `/me/avatar`).

**Key design rules (`decisiones.md` & §6.9)**
- **Magic-byte sniffing (no extension trust):** inspect file headers to allow strictly:
  - Images (`max 10 MB`; avatars `max 5 MB`): `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`.
  - Documents (`max 50 MB`): `application/pdf`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, and Office OOXML/ODF (`docx`, `xlsx`, `odt`, `ods` — verified as ZIP magic bytes + expected internal entry such as `word/document.xml`, `xl/workbook.xml`, `mimetype` = ODF).
  - Any unsupported MIME → `415 unsupported_media_type`; size exceeded → `413 file_too_large`.
- **Memory-safe image processing (`-Xmx256m`):** read image header dimensions *before* decoding pixels (via `ImageReader.getWidth/getHeight`); if `width * height > 64_000_000` (64 MP) reject with `413 file_too_large` without allocating the bitmap. Run decoding/resizing on `Dispatchers.IO` bounded by a `Semaphore(permits = 2)` so concurrent uploads never OOM. Resize longest edge to ≤2000 px and produce a ≤400 px thumbnail stored under `thumb_storage_key`.
- **WebP support:** include TwelveMonkeys `imageio-webp` (or equivalent lightweight JVM ImageIO plugin) so WebP reads work reliably on JVM 21; re-encode processed images to JPEG/PNG/WebP cleanly.
- **Disk safety & cleanup:** stream uploads to a temp file under `FILES_DIR/.tmp` while enforcing byte caps, generate random UUID storage keys (never original filename on disk), move atomically to `FILES_DIR/<key>`, and delete temp/old files on error, replacement, or entity deletion.
- **Thumbnails (`decisiones.md`):** expose `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/thumb/{filename}` (referenced in `FileRef.thumbUrl`) applying the exact same access check as `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/{filename}`.
- **Owner-based visibility matrix:** file visibility is derived dynamically from the owning entity's current state (e.g., an event image becomes public only while `event.published == true`; a user avatar becomes public only while `user.status == active && consent.publicProfile == true && !isMinor`; `Document.file` is always protected for `board`/`admin` with `Content-Disposition: attachment`).

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test` passes.
- Fake `.jpg` containing plain text or script returns `415 unsupported_media_type`.
- Image header > 64 MP returns `413 file_too_large` without allocating full raster.
- Uploading an image > 2000 px resizes main file to ≤ 2000 px and creates a ≤ 400 px thumbnail reachable via `FileRef.thumbUrl`.
- Replacing or deleting `/me/avatar` removes the previous main + thumbnail files from `FILES_DIR`.
- Protected files require valid Bearer with owner permissions (`404` when unauthorized/forbidden); public files succeed anonymously with long `Cache-Control`.
- Document downloads send `Content-Disposition: attachment` (sanitized filename) and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
shared_ui_policy: No UI in this slice. Webapp consumes protected files via `SessionManager.fetchAuthorizedBytes()` (Ktor Client with `Authorization: Bearer`) and renders upload pickers inside each feature slice.
out_of_scope:
- Entity-specific upload routes other than `/me/avatar` (each feature slice wires its own routes calling `FileStorageService`: calendar image/gallery, members avatar, inventory image, group/achievement logo/image, figure image, documents multipart).
- External CDN or object storage (local `FILES_DIR` on VPS per §2).
- UI file pickers (owned by feature slices).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: N/A in this slice (webapp sends `Authorization: Bearer` via Ktor Client for protected downloads).
auth.server: `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/{filename}` and `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/thumb/{filename}` use optional Bearer authentication and delegate authorization to `FileAccessPolicy` (`404 not_found` when private and caller lacks permission). `PUT/DELETE /api/v1/me/avatar` require Bearer.

components.name: MagicByteSniffer
components.usage: Detect actual MIME type from file header bytes (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF) and safe ZIP inspection for DOCX/XLSX/ODT/ODS without trusting filename or `Content-Type` header.
components.notes: No heavy Apache Tika dependency (keep `-Xmx256m` and small fat JAR).

components.name: ImagePipeline
components.usage: Check dimensions before decode (reject > 64 MP with `413 file_too_large`), guard concurrency with `Semaphore(2)` on `Dispatchers.IO`, resize to max 2000 px, and generate 400 px thumbnail.

components.name: FileStorageService
components.usage: Reusable service for all feature slices: `storeImage(ownerType, ownerId, field, maxBytes, part)`, `storeDocument(ownerId, part)`, `deleteStoredFile(fileId)`, `toFileRef(storedFile)` building `url` + optional `thumbUrl` from `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`.
components.notes: Cleans temp files on failure and deletes disk blobs only after DB transaction commits (post-commit hook).

components.name: FileAccessPolicy
components.usage: Evaluates whether a `stored_files` row is publicly readable or permitted for a given `AuthPrincipal` based on `owner_type`, `owner_id`, `field`, and live entity state in SQLite.

components.name: Files.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for inserting, fetching, and deleting `stored_files`, plus lightweight visibility lookups by `owner_type`/`owner_id`.

components.name: FileRoutes
components.notes: Enforces `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, sanitized `Content-Disposition` (attachment for documents), `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for public files (random IDs) and `private, no-store` for protected files.

structure:
Upload & download architecture:

```text
Multipart upload (PUT /me/avatar or feature upload route)
  → Stream part to FILES_DIR/.tmp/<uuid> enforcing maxBytes (5 MB / 10 MB / 50 MB)
  → MagicByteSniffer validates real MIME (415 if unsupported)
  → If image: ImagePipeline checks header dimensions ≤ 64 MP (413), Semaphore(2), resize ≤2000 px + thumb ≤400 px
  → Atomic move to FILES_DIR/<storageKey> (+ <thumbStorageKey>)
  → DB writeTransaction: insert stored_files + update owner *_file_id + bump version
  → Post-commit: delete previous stored_files row & old disk files
  → Return FileRef(id, url, thumbUrl, contentType, size)

Download (GET /api/v1/files/{id}/{filename} or /thumb/{filename})
  → Load stored_files by id (404 if missing)
  → FileAccessPolicy checks owner entity state + optional Bearer principal (404 if denied)
  → Stream file from FILES_DIR with nosniff + Cache-Control + Content-Disposition
```

sections.title: Owner visibility matrix (`FileAccessPolicy`)
sections.description: Visibility is evaluated against the current DB state of the owning record (never solely a static flag, so unpublishing an event or revoking `publicProfile` immediately hides its files):
sections.behavior:
- `user.avatar`: **public** iff `user.status == 'active' && consent_public_profile == 1 && !isMinor`; otherwise **private** to self, `staff`, `board`, `admin` (plus any authenticated `member` if the user holds an active `org_role` shown in internal `/org-chart`).
- `event.image` / `event.gallery`: **public** iff `event.published == 1`; otherwise any authenticated `member`+.
- `group.logo` / `group.image` / `achievement.logo`: **public**.
- `figure.image`: **public** iff `figure.status != 'retired'`; otherwise any authenticated `member`+.
- `inventory_item.image`: **private** (`board`, `admin` only).
- `document.file`: **always protected** (`board`, `admin` only), served with `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<sanitized>"`.

sections.title: Thumbnail route (`FileRef.thumbUrl`)
sections.description: Every processed image stores both `storage_key` (≤2000 px) and `thumb_storage_key` (≤400 px). `FileRef.url` points to `{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/api/v1/files/{id}/{safeName}` and `FileRef.thumbUrl` points to `{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/api/v1/files/{id}/thumb/{safeName}`.
sections.behavior: For non-image documents (`PDF`, `DOCX`, `XLSX`, `ODT`, `ODS`), `thumb_storage_key` and `FileRef.thumbUrl` are `null`; requesting `/thumb/` on a non-image returns `404`.

sections.title: Multipart limits & Netty event-loop safety
sections.description: Upload routes bypass the 1 MB JSON body limit from `platform-server-infra` and enforce per-endpoint caps (5 MB avatar, 10 MB images, 50 MB documents; Caddy allows up to 60 MB).
sections.behavior: All disk I/O, ZIP entry inspection, and ImageIO resizing run strictly on `Dispatchers.IO`. On upload failure or DB rollback, delete newly written files in a `finally` block so `FILES_DIR` never leaks orphan blobs.

endpoints.name: Download file
endpoints.notes: Public or Bearer depending on `FileAccessPolicy`; `404` if unauthorized/forbidden. `Content-Disposition: attachment` for documents.

endpoints.name: Download image thumbnail
endpoints.notes: 400 px thumbnail for images with identical `FileAccessPolicy` checks; `404` for non-images.

endpoints.name: Upload own avatar
endpoints.notes: Multipart field `file` (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5 MB). Returns updated `FileRef` (or `UserSelf`).

persistence: Uses `stored_files` from SQLite v0.2 (`Files.sq`) + local directory `FILES_DIR` (random storage keys, temp staging under `FILES_DIR/.tmp`).

tasks.title: Add WebP ImageIO dependency & MagicByteSniffer
tasks.spec: Add lightweight WebP ImageIO dependency (e.g. TwelveMonkeys `imageio-webp`) to `gradle/libs.versions.toml` and `server/build.gradle.kts`. Implement `MagicByteSniffer` detecting JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, and OOXML/ODF (`docx`, `xlsx`, `odt`, `ods`) by content bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests accept real JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/ODT/ODS headers and reject disguised text/HTML/EXE files with `415 unsupported_media_type`

tasks.title: ImagePipeline (64 MP guard, 2000 px resize, 400 px thumb)
tasks.spec: Implement `ImagePipeline` on `Dispatchers.IO` with `Semaphore(2)`: inspect dimensions via `ImageReader` before decoding (> 64 MP → `413 file_too_large`), scale down if longest side > 2000 px, and generate a ≤ 400 px thumbnail.
acceptance_criteria: Test verifies a crafted header claiming > 64 MP returns `413 file_too_large` without OOM
Test verifies a 3000×1500 image produces a 2000×1000 main file and 400×200 thumbnail

tasks.title: Files.sq + FileStorageService
tasks.spec: Add `Files.sq` and `FileStorageService` with streaming size-capped temp upload, random disk keys, post-commit cleanup of replaced/deleted files, rollback cleanup of temp files, and `FileRef` builder (`url` + `thumbUrl`). Wire in Koin `ServerModules`.
acceptance_criteria: Replacing a file removes previous main + thumb blobs from `FILES_DIR`
Oversized upload aborts early with `413 file_too_large` and leaves zero temp files

tasks.spec: Implement `FileAccessPolicy` (full owner visibility matrix), `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/{filename}`, `GET /api/v1/files/{id}/thumb/{filename}`, `PUT /api/v1/me/avatar`, and `DELETE /api/v1/me/avatar`. Set `nosniff`, `Cache-Control`, and sanitized `Content-Disposition: attachment` for documents. Update `openapi.yaml` and `MuixerangaApi` (`uploadMyAvatar`, `deleteMyAvatar`).
acceptance_criteria: `:server:test` verifies public vs private visibility transitions (e.g. unpublishing event hides its image → `404`)
`:server:test` verifies minor's avatar is never accessible anonymously
`:server:test` verifies document download requires `board`/`admin` and sends `Content-Disposition: attachment`
